# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 09 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launch Update

- **Thomson Reserve sells 90.1% at launch, all 3- and 4-bedroom units taken up** - Buyers purchased 1,143 of 1,268 homes at an average price of S$2,900 psf, making it the year's best-selling new condominium launch. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/thomson-reserve-launch-sales/)

## HDB Resale & BTO

- **Million-dollar HDB resales hit third straight monthly record in October 2026** - A record 238 HDB resale flats transacted at S$1 million or above in October 2026 — up from 209 in September — representing 10.9% of October's total resale volume. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/million-dollar-hdb-resale-record-october-2026/)

- **November 2026 BTO launch offers 7,964 flats across seven projects** - HDB launched flats in Bedok, Geylang, Sembawang, Tengah, Toa Payoh and Yishun on 4 November — the final BTO exercise of the year and the first under higher income ceilings for families. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/november-2026-bto-launch-highlights/)

- **February 2027 BTO preview: around 4,300 flats in Bishan, Tampines, Tengah and Toa Payoh** - HDB's next BTO exercise will run alongside a Sale of Balance Flats exercise offering about 5,000 flats, bringing combined supply to roughly 9,300 homes. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/february-2027-bto-launch-preview/)

- **Yishun executive flat sets new record at S$1.329M despite being smaller than previous record holder** - A 1,765 sq ft executive flat at Block 652 Yishun Ave 4 changed hands at S$1.329M (S$753 psf), surpassing the prior record even though it is 183 sq ft smaller. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/yishun-executive-flat-crossed-1-3m/)

## Buyer Risk Reminder

- **84 Singapore homebuyers win S$3.3M payout after JB developer delays** - Buyers of a Johor Bahru luxury condo successfully sued their developer over project delays and were awarded over S$3M in total payouts, though compensation varied across individual buyers. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/rf-princess-cove-buyers-awarded/)
